verdict: Organic engagement holding overall, but search visibility is dropping across all entities.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your combined Google Business Profile activity generated 385 total actions this period — all of it organic, with no paid channels active. O'Hare's GBP engagement rose 31% week-over-week, which is a genuine positive, but both Forte and Advance saw sharp GBP and search click declines of 40–50%, pointing to a real drop in local search visibility that is not noise. A web and SEO root-cause fix is now in motion, with three sites targeted for reindexing by end of October, which should begin reversing the search slide. Several CRM and outreach workstreams that were due in August and September are being resolved in parallel; completion this month will unlock revenue tracking and activate cold outreach sequences for the first time.
